mutants.description: pgood_gen gets the inverted modulator PWM, so it counts its qualifying cycles at high-side turn-on (the cycle boundary fault_arbiter uses) instead of at the end of each pulse
mutants.reason: In S_RUN with the rail in window, PGOOD and switch_supply rise on a PWM rising edge instead of a falling one, so the moment they assert moves by the PWM on-time. The PGOOD qualifying count also starts from a different edge after each entry into S_RUN.

mutants.description: strike_counter counts a strike on the overcurrent window trip itself instead of on entry into S_HICCUP, as if 'a strike' were the trip rather than the hiccup it causes
mutants.reason: strike_level and latch_out change one clock early, on the clock the FSM leaves S_SS/S_RUN rather than the clock after it enters S_HICCUP. A trip on the same clock as a hard fault (OTP, UVLO, switch off) sends the FSM to S_OFF, yet a strike is still counted, so later hiccups are longer and latch_out trips early.

mutants.description: MISO is retimed through an extra clk flop 'to deglitch it', though the header says both terms are already flops and MISO is driven straight from them
mutants.reason: Every MISO transition during a read comes one clk later than spi_slave's shift edge. On deselect, MISO stays high for one extra clock after sdio_oe has dropped.
